name: South Korea
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: kimchi refrigerator
inventions.description: A kimchi refrigerator is a refrigerator designed specifically to meet the storage requirements of kimchi and facilitate different fermentation processes.

inventions.name: Ch'ŭgugi
inventions.description: Ch'ŭgugi were rain gauges invented and used during the Joseon dynasty of Korea.

inventions.name: Plate armour
inventions.description: Plate armour is a historical type of personal body armour made from bronze, iron, or steel plates, culminating in suits of armour which entirely or mostly encased the wearer.

inventions.name: Pistol
inventions.description: A pistol is a type of handgun, characterized by a barrel with an integral chamber.

inventions.name: Hwacha
inventions.description: The hwacha or hwach'a was a fifteenth-century Korean weapons platform capable of performing both the multiple rocket launcher or a volley gun roles.

inventions.name: Airplane
inventions.description: An airplane, or aeroplane, also plane, is a fixed-wing aircraft that is propelled forward by thrust from a jet engine, propeller, or rocket engine.

inventions.name: Warship
inventions.description: A warship or combatant ship is a naval ship that is used for naval warfare.

inventions.name: Bulletproof vest
inventions.description: A bulletproof vest, also known as a ballistic vest or bullet-resistant vest, is a type of body armor designed to absorb impact and prevent the penetration of firearm projectiles and explosion fragments to the torso.

inventions.name: Musket
inventions.description: A musket is a muzzle-loaded long gun that appeared as a smoothbore weapon in the early 16th century, at first as a heavier variant of the arquebus, capable of penetrating plate armour.

inventions.name: Machine gun
inventions.description: A machine gun (MG) is a fully automatic and rifled firearm designed for sustained direct fire.

inventions.name: Janggu
inventions.description: The janggu or seyogo is a drum often used in traditional Korean music.

inventions.name: Gayageum
inventions.description: The gayageum or kayagum is a traditional Korean musical instrument.
